_note: Android counterpart to scan_rules_ios.json -- see that file's own _note for the full schema. Android has no Cellebrite/GrayKey path-prefix quirk (both tools use identical bare 'data/data/'/'data/media/' paths), so no prefix_shortcut()-style transform is needed here.

rules._note: Every user's credential-encrypted app data: owner (0, the same folder as data/data, which some tools store as a second copy), second users, work profile, Android 15 Private Space. Added 2026-11-15 (EVIDENCE_LOCATIONS.md).
Device-encrypted app data per user; SMS/MMS (mmssms.db) and the call log (calllog.db) normally live here on current Android. Added 2026-11-15 (EVIDENCE_LOCATIONS.md).
Packages, app-ops, settings XML (users/<u>), shutdown checkpoints, batterystats, older usagestats and notification_log.db. Added 2026-11-15 (EVIDENCE_LOCATIONS.md).
Per-user credential-encrypted system data: accounts_ce.db, usagestats, notification history, recent tasks and snapshots. Added 2026-11-15 (EVIDENCE_LOCATIONS.md).
Per-user device-encrypted system data: accounts_de.db. Added 2026-11-15 (EVIDENCE_LOCATIONS.md).
Wi-Fi (misc/wifi, misc/apexdata/com.android.wifi), Bluetooth, bootstat, ADB keys. Added 2026-11-15 (EVIDENCE_LOCATIONS.md).
Per-user credential-encrypted misc data, e.g. a per-user Wi-Fi config copy (Android 11+). Added 2026-11-15 (EVIDENCE_LOCATIONS.md).
Per-user device-encrypted misc data, e.g. runtime permissions and roles (Android 11+). Added 2026-11-15 (EVIDENCE_LOCATIONS.md).
Samsung device logs (e.g. power-off reset reason). Added 2026-11-15 (EVIDENCE_LOCATIONS.md).
